name: leashed-agent
description: A policy-controlled wallet for an AI purchasing agent (SDG 2: Zero Hunger). The contract enforces spending rules so a hijacked agent cannot drain funds.

scripts.demo: concurrently -k -n chain,api,web -c green,yellow,cyan "npm run chain" "wait-on tcp:127.0.0.1:8545 && npm run deploy && npm run data-api" "wait-on tcp:127.0.0.1:8545 && npm run web"
